svg.title: Diagrams illustrating the definitions of upper bound and lower bound of a subset Y within a larger set X
svg.desc: Top: within X, every element of Y relates to a candidate x by yRx, making x an upper bound, x in Y superscript u. Bottom: within X, a candidate x relates to every element of Y by xRy, making x a lower bound, x in Y superscript l.
svg.text: Upper bound: y R x for every y ∈ Y
Lower bound: x R y for every y ∈ Y
